title: Meta tells Ray-Ban Display developers its untrusted-content flag is not enforced
why_it_matters_hint: Only the headline could be read: developers were told a flag marking untrusted content is not enforced on Meta's smart glasses.
notes: MIXED Reality News returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare security page); the saved text file holds only that page. One Google News search returned this outlet's headline and no other outlet with the story.
